sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: A balanced diet provides what?

options.D: Appropriate amounts of energy and essential nutrients

questions.explanation: A balanced diet contains adequate nutrients in suitable proportions.

questions.question: Why should hands be washed before preparing food?

options.C: To reduce transfer of harmful microorganisms

questions.explanation: Handwashing helps prevent food contamination.

questions.explanation: Drying reduces available moisture for many spoilage organisms.
